overview.oneLineTake: An oil-supply shock, bond-market revolt, and resurgent inflation are overwhelming isolated earnings beats and forcing a stagflationary repricing across risk assets.
themes: Oil-supply shock: Brent/WTI break $100, diesel hits records, Hormuz tanker attacks and Iran war escalation threaten sustained energy inflation
Global bond revolt: 10Y Treasury nears 5%, mortgage rates top 7%, ECB hikes to 2.5%, and Bessent’s buybacks fail to arrest the selloff
Stagflationary impulse: Surging energy costs and shipping risk are forcing markets to price Fed hikes into a slowing economy
Political risk premium: US-Canada trade war, Trump’s $5K dividend proposal, and midterm uncertainty are compounding policy instability
risks: Fed forced to hike into oil-driven inflation as Treasury yields breach multi-year highs
Hormuz closure or wider Iran escalation could freeze energy supply and accelerate equity drawdowns
Treasury market is rejecting policy interventions, signaling a loss of confidence in fiscal/monetary coordination
